text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said Tuesday it had completed the acquisition of 12 businesses in the United States and New Zealand for a total of $153 million.
It said it paid $70 million in cash and $83 million in stock.
The acquired companies have combined annualized revenues of $175 million,, U.S. Office Products said.
The acquisitions will be accretive to earnings, it said.
The firms purchased include private companies, public companies, and units of public companies.
According to a U.S. Office Products spokeswoman, the names of the public companies have not yet been disclosed because employees have not yet been notified.

The newly purchased private companies are Adair Office Furniture of Cerritos, Calif.; Allied School & Office Supplies of Albuquerque, N.M.; Associated Travel Services Inc of Santa Ana, Calif.; LBM Office Products Inc of Lake Charles, La.; Link Printing PTY Ltd of New Zealand; McCollam Printers Ltd of New Zealand; Packaging Solutions Ltd of New Zealand; Rapid Labels Ltd of New Zealand; and Town and Country Business Products Inc of Eagen, Minn.
